title: Summa billing.record provenance fragment (summa.billing-record/1)
description: The provenance-bearing portion of a Summa billing record (docs/requirements/SUMMA-PROVENANCE.md INV-PROV-001..004, DF-SUMMA-PROV-2026-0001). Identity is the Praxis actor and provenance is the Praxis praxis.provenance/1 block (schemas vendored unchanged under vendor/praxis-provenance/); Summa defines no second identity model. Provenance is optional everywhere: a billing record without it is valid and billable, and its provenance reads as unknown. A source's block is carried verbatim, including a block of another major version. This schema is the structural floor; lib/billing-record-provenance.mjs enforces the rules JSON Schema cannot express (credential tripwire, contribution-history invariants). Identity is self-reported provenance, not authentication or authorization (RQ-ROS-2026-A019).

sources.description: Every billable source that contributed to this record. Grouping never removes a source or its provenance (INV-AUD-004, INV-CHR-010).

carriedProvenance.description: A Praxis praxis.provenance/1 block. A block tagged with another major version is outside this floor and is carried verbatim.
